output:
**Subject:** Order TH-48217: not delivered, need resend or full refund by Fri 13 Nov

Hi there,

I'm writing about order TH-48217, placed on 21 October and paid in full (R1,640 including the R95 delivery fee, by card). I'm frustrated, and I'd rather get this sorted than go back and forth.

The tracking says the order was delivered to Bergview Pre-Primary in Plumstead on Tuesday 3 November at 11:42 and signed for by "M. Adams". Nobody at the school is called Adams, and our gate security keeps a log of every delivery. There's no entry for the 3rd. As far as the school is concerned, nothing arrived.

I emailed you on 4 November and again on 6 November. Both times I got the same reply saying my query had been escalated to your courier partner. On Friday I phoned and spent 38 minutes on hold, only to be told nothing can be done until the courier finishes an investigation, which could take 10 working days. I understand couriers are part of your delivery process, but I didn't choose the courier and I don't have a contract with them. I paid Tiny Hands Edu Supplies, so getting the goods to me is your responsibility.

This matters because I'm a kindergarten teacher and the children are waiting. They made their masks pattern last week, and I've been telling them the finger paint is "coming soon" for a week. The end-of-year concert is on 27 November, and several of the props depend on these supplies. I bought everything with my own money, and R1,640 is a lot to be out of pocket on a teacher's salary, especially for materials for other people's children. I've shopped with you three times before without any problems, which is why this has been so disappointing.

I need one of the following:

1. The full order resent to the school with a tracking number I can follow, in time for the concert on 27 November, or
2. A full refund of R1,640, including the delivery fee.

Please confirm which you're doing by Friday 13 November. I'd also like a reply from a person who has actually looked at my order, not another template. If I don't hear from you by then, I'll have to dispute the payment with my bank and leave a review about my experience, which I'd really rather not do after shopping with you before.

Thank you for your time. I hope we can sort this out quickly.

Kind regards,

[Your name]
Kindergarten teacher, Bergview Pre-Primary
[Phone number]
